holdout_policy: No outcome or trajectory at or after holdout_start may be read until one final candidate passes the full calibration gate and is frozen.

v4_failure.interpretation: The fixed lighting basis changed the heat balance, invalidating the cDgh selected under v3 lighting and slightly invalidating the prior grow-pipe capacity boundary.

capacity_derived_fix.selection_rule: Scale by the v4 capacity ratio and round downward; do not choose using climate RMSE.

selection_objective.primary: minimize the maximum RMSE divided by its frozen gate across tAir, rhIn, and co2InPpm for pooled data and every compartment
selection_objective.tie_breaker: minimize the mean pooled normalized RMSE across the three channels

full_calibration_check: Run exactly one selected candidate on all 21 continuous calibration sequences and require the frozen gate pooled and for every compartment before holdout access.
